guards: one exact canonical owner selected by id/path
ordinary semantic mode resolves current owner/state/lane dependencies internally; explicit revision arguments remain a low-level compatibility surface
preview returns an executable revision-bound semantic action and changed fields without writes
preview projects the exact delta while apply reruns a sealed internal preflight bound to target/worktree mutation baseline, Planning, owner, lane, request revisions, and expiry
apply rejects caller-built timestamp/lookalike bearer tokens and writes owner/projection updates and the admitted preflight evidence atomically
replay is idempotent only while the recorded owner/state/lane postcondition remains live
ordinary semantic mode rejects caller-authored lifecycle, phase, proof, relationship, and parent consequences that source transitions own

scaffold tightening supports goal, non-goals, intent continuity, execution bounds, touched paths, validation commands, completion criteria, and adaptive assurance while preserving canonical projections
completion correction remains a typed semantic mode: ordinary patches cannot directly set execution_run, finished_run_review, intent_satisfaction, execution_summary, or closure_check

completion correction requires stable correction identity, admitted review refs, a material supported source patch, and exact proposal plus target-authority guards when integration-pending truth participates

reopen atomically demotes every completion projection, restores lane work, and rejects the superseded proposal; remain-feature-complete atomically rebuilds completion truth and refreshes proposal currentness
